title: Weird
text: Weird. These blankets have very odd wording on them. Very obviously non-English speakers writing on the blankets. It just doesn’t make any sense. As far as the quality, they’re a little rough and scratchy and on the cheap side. Definitely not the nicest Muslin blankets I’ve had.

product_metadata.title: POMISO Swaddle Blankets, Soft Baby Muslin Blankets for Girls & Boys, Neutral Receiving Blankets Wrap Sets, Newborn Gifts, 45 x 45 inches, 2 Pack, Crown and Pink Wing
